sources.title: AI Patio Design | GenRoom

sources.title: Kelvin · The System of Action for the physical world
sources.snippet: Bring your own models, agents, and AI, or start with Kelvin's. As intelligence changes, Kelvin provides the persistent operational layer that connects it to the physical world. That layer is governed execution, control, measurement, and the feedback loop that turns every action into the input for the next decision.
